rows.grounds: refers to all those previously mentioned
past passive participle indicating what has been stated
anaphoric reference to the groups discussed
first member of compound indicating the highest grade
second member of compound with mukhya, denoting extent up to the chief
refers to the preceptor or ācārya
instrumental indicating authorization by the teacher

items.question: By whose authority is the full range of distinctions declared for all?
premises: Distinctions among groups were previously stated in order.
These distinctions apply to all of those groups.
The declaration extends up to the chief grade by the teacher's command.
items.inference: Therefore the full graded range of distinctions is authoritatively declared for all by the teacher's command.
uncertainties: The exact scope implied by mukhya-antaṃ in this context is inferred from the preceding graded distinctions.
items.plain_english: For all of them, this has been declared up to the chief grade, by the command of the teacher.
